# Dr. Vlad Tettegah — Cardiology & Hypnotherapy

> Dr. Vlad Tettegah (Dr Vlad) is a medical doctor, cardiologist and clinical hypnotherapist. He offers online consultations in Russian, English and French, combining evidence-based cardiology with clinical hypnotherapy for the mind–body side of heart and stress-related symptoms.

Key facts:
- Profession: Physician — cardiologist and hypnotherapist
- Education: Belarusian State Medical University
- Membership: American Society of Clinical Hypnosis (ASCH), Associate Member
- In medicine since 2019, with international clinical practice
- Consultation languages: Russian, English, French
- Brand: Dr. Vlad — Integrative Medicine & Hypnotherapy
- Contact: support@drvladt.com

How to request a consultation: fill in the intake form on the consultation page. The site issues a personal Patient ID; medical documents are uploaded separately and handled confidentially.
